name: Starbase Orbital Pad A
tagline: First Starship orbital flight test; designed for the full reusable Mars-bound stack
description: SpaceX's Starship pad at Boca Chica, Texas — built from scratch starting in 2019 for the fully reusable Starship + Super Heavy. First integrated flight test (IFT-1) lifted off April 20, 2023; vehicle loss at MaxQ but the pad survived. Subsequent IFTs through 2024-25 demonstrated booster catch via the Mechazilla tower arms, successful sea splashdowns, and increasing payload-class capability. The water deluge system at this pad is the largest ever built for an orbital launch — the over-pressure footprint from 33 Raptor 2 engines is unlike anything else flying.
best_known_for: First Starship orbital flight test; designed for the full reusable Mars-bound stack
